name: AP Top Step 9 Root Causes
query:
SELECT
    e.root_cause_tag AS "Root Cause:Data:220",
    COUNT(*) AS "Events:Int:90",
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / NULLIF((
        SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabAP Review Event` t2
        WHERE (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR DATE(t2.created) >= %(from_date)s)
          AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR DATE(t2.created) <= %(to_date)s)
    ), 0), 1) AS "%% of Total:Float:90",
    COUNT(DISTINCT e.capture) AS "Distinct Captures:Int:140"
FROM `tabAP Review Event` e
WHERE (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR DATE(e.created) >= %(from_date)s)
  AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR DATE(e.created) <= %(to_date)s)
GROUP BY e.root_cause_tag
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
